title: Following the Scriptures over Angels
english: But we align ourselves with what is written; for we have not learned the names of angels, but we follow what is written. There is no envy, no jealousy; for these are not earthly matters. Angels are not saddened because they stand while men sit; for they are partakers of the glory of the saints. Hear the Lord saying: Amen I say to you, that it is joy before all the angels over one sinner repenting (Luke 15:10). Let us therefore love the glory of Christ, but let us spread out the passing glory like a dream.
